title: Training budget and fragmentation, more than heterogeneity, drive the accuracy cost of federated household load forecasting: code and results
description: Code, configurations, per-run results and manuscript-generation scripts for a controlled study of federated LSTM household load forecasting on 100 Low Carbon London homes: fragmentation, training budget and heterogeneity are separated with an IID control, and every byte of federated traffic is counted. The LCL data are not redistributed.
